newsitem.title: USA: Interface Inc names Charles Eitel pres.
newsitem.headline: Interface Inc names Charles Eitel pres.

text.p: Interface Inc said Wednesday it appointed Charles Eitel president and chief operating officer.
Departing the positions was Ray Anderson, who will retain the offices of chairman and chief executive.

Eitel, 47, has served as executive vice president of Interface Inc and as president and chief executive officer of the Interface Floor Coverings Group, which represents 80 percent of company sales, Interface said. Eitel will retain his position with Interface Floor Coverings Group, the company said.
